prototype_note: This is an academic demonstration prototype.
consent_text: I agree that my name, mobile number, and farm details can be stored on this prototype system to give me farming advice. This information is used only for this academic demonstration and is not shared publicly. The advice is general information only.
disclaimer: This is general information only. It does not guarantee rain, yield, or income. For serious crop problems, contact your nearest KVK or agricultural officer.
callback_done_msg: Your number: {m}. An agricultural expert may contact you.
upload_choose: Choose a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)
review_retake: Consider retaking the photo in good light, closer to the leaf.
review_msg: Preliminary review only. Contact an agricultural officer for confirmation.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_validation: Please check the details in the form.
err_notfound: The page or information was not found.
err_upload: Invalid file. Please upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo (up to 5 MB).
err_size: The file is too large (up to 5 MB).
chat_hello: Hello! Ask about rain, crop stage, photo upload or expert calls. I do not give pesticide or fertiliser doses.
chat_err: Sorry, I could not answer. Please try again.
chat_hint_nomic: Voice input is not available in this browser. Use Chrome (on HTTPS or localhost) or type your question.
chat_hint_denied: Microphone permission or an internet connection is needed. Allow it and try again.
chat_hint_novoice: This phone may not have a Telugu voice. Install one in the phone's text-to-speech settings.
chat_see_page: See the advisory page for the full explanation.
